[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Minimum cost to move chips** [LC 1217 · Minimum Cost to Move Chips to The Same Position](https://leetcode.com/problems/minimum-cost-to-move-chips-to-the-same-position/){difficulty="Easy"}

Free moves preserve a chip's **parity**, and paid moves flip it. So a chip's position modulo 2 is the only thing that matters, and each chip whose parity differs from the target's costs exactly 1.

[Solved in full in @sec-pf-p6-chips.]{.card-link}
